== Notes ==
* Consider using with skills that benefit from increased health like [[Flesh of My Flesh]].
* Can be used to gain health by recasting early, ending the previous version.
* The [[sacrifice]] takes place before you gain the maximum health.  Casting this item spell whilst already under its effect will cause you to sacrifice 10% of your increased maximum health.

== Trivia ==
* "Tsungrai" in the skill icon appears to be wearing [[Assassin Seitung armor]].
